item.title: HackerRank open sourced its ATS. My resume scored 90/100. Oh wait 74. No – 88
item.description:
📝 A junior engineer with one internship gets 25/25. A principal engineer with a decade of distributed systems gets 25/25. I’d take the engineer with 30 years of experience who built S3 over someone with two internships and an open source project — but this tool wouldn’t.
🔗 Read more: https://danunparsed.com/p/hackerrank-open-source-ats

item.title: Why did this journal retract two 1940s papers by Max Planck?
item.description:
📝 So a pair of science historians were puzzled when they discovered that a scientific journal had inexplicably retracted two of Planck’s papers from the 1940s. The journal typically adds a large RETRACTED notice across digital papers that have been retracted, leaving them available for download. Screenshot/Science of Nature Screenshot/Science of Nature Screenshot/Science of Nature Screenshot/Science of Nature Screenshot/Science of Nature Screenshot/Science of Nature Gingras and Khelfaoui suspect the retraction decision was made around this time.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/06/why-did-this-journal-retract-two-1940s-papers-by-max-planck/

item.title: Herdr: Agent multiplexer that lives in your terminal
item.description:
📝 Run herdr server stop, then run herdr again for the default session. Herdr uses explicit keybinding strings. Run manually: herdr update herdr update is for installs managed by Herdr's own installer.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/ogulcancelik/herdr
